set.body:
Outcome

Replace positional sample and feature assumptions with exact scientific axes, typed columns, Multivar-backed evidence, and fixed or frozen measurement legs.

Acceptance

- Semantic keys and physical ordinals are separate.
- Dense and operator-backed evidence share one scientific representation.
- Regions and searchlights are frame builders, not core kinds.
- Wrong-owner and reordered-space cases fail closed.
- This gate closes only after every Phase 1 child closes.
set.title: P1: establish identified axes and one measurement-frame model
